scripts.dev: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.check: npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend && npm run check:mobile
scripts.debug: concurrently --names "BACKEND-CHECK,WEB-CHECK,MOBILE-CHECK" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run debug:backend" "npm run debug:frontend" "npm run debug:mobile"
scripts.debug:backend: nodemon --watch backend/src --watch backend/eslint.config.js --ext js,json --exec "npm run check:backend"
scripts.debug:frontend: nodemon --watch frontend/src --watch frontend/vite.config.js --watch frontend/eslint.config.js --ext js,jsx,css,json --exec "npm run check:frontend"
scripts.debug:mobile: nodemon --watch bantaycabagan-mobileapp/App.tsx --watch bantaycabagan-mobileapp/index.ts --watch bantaycabagan-mobileapp/src --watch bantaycabagan-mobileapp/tsconfig.json --ext ts,tsx,json --exec "npm run check:mobile"
